laws: PRIVATE/MEDICAL/MESSAGING ADAPTERS EXCLUDED FROM PUBLIC DECK
representative_interaction: ROLL or open #issue=N → OPEN TARGET → perform one bounded move → PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL → COPY RETURN JSON
